title: Named-part customization
description: Use typed named-part hooks on this real composition. Dashed boundaries illustrate the customized root; built-in focus states remain.

title: Thumbnail gallery
description: A large selected slide with a thumbnail rail underneath. Each thumbnail is a real button with aria-current, so pointer and keyboard users can switch the collection.

title: Coverflow
description: Previous and next cards recede with scale, rotation and opacity while the active card stays centred. Arrow buttons, dots and the arrow keys share one active index.

title: Peek cards
description: A centre-mode scroll-snap rail shows the active card with both neighbours peeking. Previous and next buttons, dots and arrow keys keep the selection in sync.

title: Stacked deck
description: Cards sit in a shallow deck behind the active one. Advance with the arrow buttons, dots or arrow keys; the stack re-orders around the active index.

title: Arc gallery
description: Five cards fan across a shallow arc with rotation and vertical offset by distance from the active index. The outer cards leave the stage below 640px.

title: Overflow showcase
description: Three items per page at rest, with previous and next page controls. The toggle reveals every remaining item and reports its state through aria-expanded.
